summary: This bill directs the Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere to develop a plan by September 30, 2040, to replace the current NEXRAD weather radar system with a next-generation phased array radar system and to use third-party entities to fill existing radar coverage gaps.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on developing and deploying next-generation weather radar systems and utilizing third-party entities for radar coverage. While it involves technology, it does not address data privacy, oversight, or regulation of tech companies in a way that would impact individual privacy rights or tech industry regulation.
